title: Estimating the effects of regulation when treated and control firms compete: a new method with application to the EU ETS
Quantifying Climate Damages When Regions Trade: A Structural Gravity Approach
abstract: This paper presents a method for estimating treatment effects of local climate shocks when regions trade with each other. Because trade creates spillovers, comparing the change in outcomes of regions with different exposure to shocks leads to biased estimates. We model these between-region spillovers using standard assumptions from international trade theory, and develop a model-consistent strategy for estimating key parameters and deriving counterfactuals. We use our estimation strategy to revisit the literature on the impact of climate change on gross output. We find that accounting for trade spillovers yields substantially larger climate damage projections.
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种方法，用于估计区域之间存在贸易往来时当地气候冲击的处理效应。由于贸易会产生溢出效应，比较暴露于冲击程度不同的地区其结果变化，会导致有偏估计。我们运用国际贸易理论中的标准假设对区域间的溢出效应进行建模，并提出了一种与模型保持一致的策略，用以估计关键参数并推导反事实情景。我们运用该估计策略重新审视关于气候变化对总产出影响的文献。研究发现，考虑贸易溢出效应后，气候损害的预测值显著更大。

title: Forest carbon program enrollment in Pennsylvania falls below survey predictions
abstract: Several US programs provide smaller-scale forest landowners access to carbon markets where they can earn payments in exchange for stricter timber management. We study participation in one program—the Family Forest Carbon Program—and find that 1% of likely eligible owners in five high-enrollment counties in Pennsylvania enrolled in the first 3 years, less than what landowner surveys predict. Comparisons of enrolled parcels with those of the likely eligible population reveal a similar average extent of harvesting over the 35 years prior to enrollment. Under the current owner, however, enrolled parcels had 50% more harvesting than comparable parcels. We find that more harvesting in the past 20 years reduces harvesting in the present, suggesting that, absent the Program, enrolled parcels might have less future harvests. The findings indicate that expanding carbon market access is one challenge, enrolling landowners, especially those with high offset potential, is another.
abstract_zh: 美国有若干项计划为小规模林地所有者提供进入碳市场的途径，林主可以通过实施更为严格的木材管理而获得支付。我们研究了其中一项计划——家庭林地碳计划（Family Forest Carbon Program）的参与情况，发现在宾夕法尼亚州五个高参与率县中，在最初三年内，仅有1%的可能符合条件的林主参加了该计划，这一比例低于土地所有者调查的预测。将已参加计划的地块与可能符合条件的总体进行比较后发现，在入组前的35年里，两者的平均采伐程度相近。然而，在现任所有者名下时，已入组地块的采伐量比可比地块高出50%。我们发现，过去20年间采伐越多，当前的采伐就越少，这表明在没有该计划的情况下，已入组地块未来的采伐量可能会更少。研究结果表明，扩大碳市场准入是一项挑战，而动员土地所有者参加，尤其是那些具有较高碳汇潜力的所有者，则是另一项挑战。
